, Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted the phrase "held after the 2016 Michigan Democratic primary" to mean the next presidential election cycle (2020) rather than recognizing that the 58th quadrennial election—the 2016 U.S. presidential election—was held in November 2016, which is indeed after the March 2016 Michigan Democratic primary.
